name: Marcy's Mexican Food
notes: Router had no website on record. A search result named 'marcysmexicanfood.shop' as the restaurant's own domain, but curl -sIL shows it 301-redirects to marcys-mexican-food.localoria.com - localoria.com is explicitly named on the playbook's barred brand-twin farm list, so this was discarded as a farm, not used as an own-site source. Found and used the Uber Eats storefront instead; address confirmed 756 Ventura Pl from the page's streetAddress field, matching the work list. Extracted 68 items from the escaped __REACT_QUERY_STATE__ payload by regex against catalogItems arrays (uuid/title/itemDescription/price in integer cents), using each section's preceding 'title':{'text':...} block as the section name, per playbook technique - the whole-blob JSON.parse failed because a nested 'metaJson' FAQ field uses %5C-escaped inner JSON that breaks a naive \u0022 decode, so metaJson was stripped before decoding rather than guessed at. Markup test: 62/68 prices end in .99, 4 in .00, 2 in .50 - dominated by a single conventional ending, no divisor (1.04-1.30, 0.96) clears above 17/68 - passes, no markup. Uber Eats is a tier-3 single source with no reachable own-site cross-check, so confidence is capped at medium. Sections: Birria, Combinations, Burritos, Tortas, Tacos, Mini Tacos, Mains, Enchiladas, Desserts, Side Orders, House Specials, Seafood, Nachos and Fries, Beverages. Nothing inferred, merged, divided, or truncated; 14 duplicate 'Picked for you' carousel rows (matched by uuid) were deduped, not double-counted.

name: Rosati's Pizza
notes: Router had no-platform. DoorDash marketplace listing (address-confirmed 337 N El Camino Real) was tried first and rejected: dividing its 91 prices by 1.20 lands 62/91 (68%) on conventional cent endings, a dominant divisor indicating a 20% delivery markup, per playbook must-not-divide-out rule. Instead used the restaurant's own chain ordering platform, linked from myrosatis.com/encinitas/ itself: order.myrosatis.com/rosatis_encinitas, an ArrowPOS-based storefront; address confirmed '337 N El Camino Real, Encinitas, CA 92024' directly in its embedded store-config JSON. Brace-balanced-parsed the page's embedded categories array (976KB of nested JSON) rather than a lazy regex, per playbook guidance on nested structures. Extracted 63 unambiguous, directly-priced dishes: Wings, Appetizers (13), Salads (8), Sandwiches (11), Pasta (8), Desserts (6), Beverages, plus 5 base Build-Your-Own cheese-pizza sizes (10"/12"/14"/16"/18") read from the pizza size matrix's zero-topping price cell. Explicitly EXCLUDED and NOT guessed: 12 named specialty pizzas (Hawaiian, Fabulous Four, Meat Mania, Classic Combo, The Windy City, Veggie, White Pizza, Rosati's Monster, Pesto Grilled Chicken, Buffalo Chicken, Chicago Style, 12" Gluten Free) and Calzone - each carries only a 'level_price' surcharge table layered on a shared size matrix, and the combination formula that produces the final on-screen price could not be confirmed from the static payload; rather than construct a plausible-looking number, these were left out. This means the Pizza section is present but incomplete (base cheese only, no named specialties) - flagged here rather than filed as a complete pizza menu. Markup test on the 63 kept dishes: cents cluster on .00/.25/.50/.95 (plausible printed-menu pattern), no divisor signal. Nothing constructed or guessed for any row that was written.
